title: Hovering a name in a report chart legend shows the latest value and month
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two) have clocked time at {Location-A} in the last twelve months, so both are listed in the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization report chart legends on Last 12 months.
  • Service advisors {Advisor-A} and {Advisor-B} (for example Admin ShopView and ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Two) have invoiced work with clocked time at {Location-A} in the last twelve months, so both are listed in the Advisor Analysis report chart legend on Last 12 months.
  • On the Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization reports the chart is shown (the chart button beside the filters reads Hide chart).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Advisor Analysis in the left menu.
  2. Set the Date control to Last 12 months.
  3. Hover {Advisor-A}'s name in the legend above the chart and read the box that appears.
  4. Hover {Advisor-A}'s last point on the chart and read its value and month.
  5. Click Technician Efficiency in the left menu, set the Date control to Last 12 months and hover {Technician-A}'s name in the legend.
  6. Click Technician Utilization in the left menu, set the Date control to Last 12 months and hover {Technician-A}'s name in the legend.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The box shows {Advisor-A}'s name, their most recent value and the month it is from (for example 120% and Aug 2026).
  • Step 3: The box shows no average: no "avg" figure and no other figure for the whole range anywhere in it.
  • Steps 3 and 4: The value and the month in the box match the last point on {Advisor-A}'s line.
  • Steps 5 and 6: On the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization report charts the box shows {Technician-A}'s most recent value and its month (for example 70% and Aug 2026), with no average.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; stories SV-9583 (Story 11, Chart on the Report Page) and SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S9-R10 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 12 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14) and S11-R7 (the report page shows the dashboard's own chart); read 14 Oct 2026. The design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge) boards 11_saa_Legend, 12_te_Legend and 13_tu_Legend show an average in the box; PRD version 45 (14 Oct 2026) says the box shows no average, and we take the later PRD as prevailing. Source-verified 14 October 2026. This version of the case has not yet been checked against a build (the previous version was last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R10: “Hovering a name in a chart legend shows that person's most recent value and the month it is from, for example "120% · Aug 2026". It shows no average; the table beside the chart gives the figure for the whole range.”
  • S11-R7: “The embedded chart shows the same figures as the report it sits on.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026.
